raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "bataclan (French, 1865) from batailler (to fight) + -an; or from Spanish bataclán, a vaudeville troupe; cf. Old French bataille",
    "reading": "A noisy, clattering spectacle; a place of clamor and theatrical disorder.",
    "languages": ["fr", "es", "la"],
    "source": "Le Robert historique de la langue française",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "ba + ta + clan; ba (basse, low) + ta (tac, click) + clan (tribe, faction)",
    "reading": "Low clicking tribe — a hidden kinship of rhythmic, percussive sounds.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "bataclan ~ bat (English, flying mammal) + aclan (Arabic 'aqlan, عقلاً, 'by reason'); also bataclan ~ batá (Yoruba drum) + clan",
    "reading": "A reasoned drumming — the bat's echo as a call to ancestral rhythm.",
    "languages": ["en", "ar", "yo"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "bataclan → can't a lab? → lab can ta; also 'clan taba' (taba = drum in some dialects)",
    "reading": "The laboratory of the drum — a hidden workshop where noise becomes order.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "B.T.C.L.N. → Bruit, Tapage, Clameur, Lamentation, Nuit (noise, uproar, clamor, lament, night)",
    "reading": "An acronym of sonic excess: noise, uproar, clamor, lament, and night.",
    "languages": ["fr", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "B (2nd letter, duality) + A (1st, unity) + T (cross, tau) + A (again) + C (3rd, trinity) + L (12th, completion) + A + N (14th, transformation)",
    "reading": "Duality and unity meet the cross, trinity, completion, and transformation — a spiral of becoming.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "B=2, A=1, T=20, A=1, C=3, L=12, A=1, N=14 → sum 54; 54 = 5+4 = 9 (completion, initiation)",
    "reading": "The sum 54 reduces to 9 — the number of initiation and the end of a cycle.",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "ba-ta-clan; 'ta' (French, 'your') + 'clan' (Gaelic, 'children') — 'your children'",
    "reading": "Your children — a hidden filiation, the offspring of sound and fury.",
    "languages": ["fr", "gd"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "from Italian battacchio (a wooden clapper) via French; battacchio → bataclan",
    "reading": "A wooden clapper — the original noisemaker, a tool of theatrical percussion.",
    "languages": ["it", "fr"],
    "source": "Dictionnaire étymologique de la langue française (Bloch & Wartburg)",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "bataclan ~ bataklan (Turkish batak, 'swamp' + klan, 'clan') — swamp clan",
    "reading": "A swamp clan — a hidden tribe dwelling in murky, resonant depths.",
    "languages": ["tr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "bataclan → 'cabalant' (from cabale, secret intrigue) — anagram of cabal + ant",
    "reading": "The cabal ant — a secret, industrious conspiracy of tiny movers.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "B (bêtise, folly) + A (art) + T (tragedy) + A (absurd) + C (comedy) + L (lyric) + A (allegory) + N (nihil)",
    "reading": "Folly, art, tragedy, absurdity, comedy, lyric, allegory, and nothing — a full theatre of being.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  }
]
